description: The file defines an abstract class 'AbstractErrorRenderer' inside the 'Slim\Error' namespace. It provides base methods for rendering error messages in different formats, handling exceptions of type 'HttpException' or generic throwable exceptions. It implements the 'ErrorRendererInterface' and contains protected properties and methods related to error message generation.

classes.name: AbstractErrorRenderer
classes.description: An abstract error renderer providing base functionality for handling and formatting error messages in different formats within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: getErrorTitle
methods.description: Returns the error title based on the exception; if the exception is an HttpException, retrieves its title, otherwise returns a default error title.

methods.name: getErrorDescription
methods.description: Returns the error description based on the exception; if the exception is an HttpException, retrieves its description, otherwise returns a default error description.
